Gemini AI Video Editor 1.0.0 — First Release

- Launches AI-powered video editing skill, leveraging Google's Gemini multimodal backend.
- Supports automatic token setup and session management for quick start.
- Handles common video editing actions: script generation, B-roll suggestions, video trim/cut requests, and more.
- Integrates cloud-based processing for uploads, exports, and smart edit suggestions.
- Supports multiple video/audio/image file formats on upload and export.
- Includes robust credit management, error handling, and action routing based on user intent.
